info.description: Discrepancy audit comparing author-claimed vs. engine-calculated nutritional values

recipe.description: The recipe being audited (1:0..1 — at most one audit per recipe)

authorGL.description: Glycemic Load value as claimed by the recipe author

systemGL.description: Glycemic Load value recalculated by the metabolic engine from USDA data

authorNetCarbs.description: Net carbohydrate value as claimed by the recipe author

systemNetCarbs.description: Net carbohydrate value recalculated by the metabolic engine

flagged.description: True if any delta exceeds the 1.0 discrepancy threshold

status.description: Audit verdict — 'pending' enforced automatically when discrepancy > 1.0

auditedByDietitian.description: The dietitian who performed or reviewed this audit
